how-to-use-jabbazi:
📖 **YOUR QUICK GUIDE**
🟢 **BET NOW** — qualified at the quoted price; official plays appear only on the Main Card.
🟡 **WATCH** — research, not a wager.
🔵 **PRICE CHECK** — verify the exact current sportsbook quote.
⚪ **PASS** — no supported play.
🔴 **QUARANTINED** — blocked by data or model risk.
**UNAVAILABLE** — required data is missing.

**1u = $30** unless officially changed. A sheet lean or external capper’s unit size is not an official JABBAZI stake.

This guide is read-only. Ask questions in #general, see #get-access for VIP, and use #results to review official performance.
